performance_case.causal_mechanism: The sole daily research heartbeat is the only path that can advance prospective evidence and canonical Coach outbox state. Making its liveness depend on a platform cross-task messaging capability that was absent in the scheduled occurrence can stop evidence acquisition even when every scientific, attestation, queue and writer gate passes.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This audit may recommend only one versioned operational contract slice that preserves pending events and truthful receipt state while restoring normally due heartbeat liveness. It cannot change any contract, prompt, schedule, server, canonical state, evidence gate, candidate path, OOS state, Production system or Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The audit has zero immediate drawdown effect. Its only possible future benefit is preserving uninterrupted prospective evidence needed to test later risk-adjusted mechanisms; no strategy path-risk claim follows from operational liveness.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Keeping strict V9 without the required platform capability risks repeated missed forward days and delayed R2/R1 learning. A bounded audit costs no candidate budget and must reject any remediation that adds a timer, user relay, false acknowledgement or noncanonical writer.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: This audit cannot improve fee-adjusted PnL. Restoring the sole heartbeat's liveness may reduce time to falsification and candidate readiness by preventing operational delivery debt from blocking independent prospective evidence collection.
